alerts.description: Wind speed elevated to 47 km/h (+37% over 2h) along traverse corridor.
Optical visibility decreased by 28% to 5.4 km due to blowing ground drift.
Tidal cracks detected across shelf margin sector 4.
CC-01 minor hydraulic valve delay resolved.
Transfer buffer tank at 38% capacity pending FT-02 dispatch.
VHF repeater solar battery back online.
Rapid atmospheric pressure drop of 8.2 hPa in 3 hours.
SV-03 halted in safe holding formation under blizzard SOP v2.
Cargo C-017 telemetry container secured in vehicle hold pending route clearance.
Automatic switchover to secondary generator cell successful.
Survey Zone A to Ice Shelf Point traversal restricted.
Snow blowers cleared southern tarmac section.
Mooring lines adjusted on Polar Explorer vessel.
Glacial melt runoff refrozen, route confirmed stable.

incidents.title: Severe Traverse Weather & Route Degradation
incidents.detected_by: ARORA Deterministic Solver + Field Anemometer Array
incidents.trigger: Increasing wind (47 km/h, +37%) + reduced visibility (5.4 km, -28%) + deteriorating shelf ice.
incidents.affected_route: R-03 (Survey Zone A -> Ice Shelf Point)
incidents.response_status: Route temporarily restricted (HOLD_POSITION). Team sheltered in SV-03 with auxiliary heating. Emergency Support ANT-031 alerted.

incidents.title: Fuel Transfer Line Low Pressure
incidents.trigger: Pressure drop in secondary fuel manifold valve #3.
incidents.response_status: Manual valve bypass engaged. Heating coils activated.

incidents.title: Satellite Repeater Power Loss
incidents.trigger: Frost buildup on solar panel collector.
incidents.response_status: Cleaned and switched to auxiliary battery. Normal transmission restored.

incidents.title: Runway Surface Glaze Friction Loss
incidents.trigger: Sudden warming glaze over packed ice apron.
incidents.response_status: Grit scarifier grooved the runway surface. Flights cleared.

incidents.title: Auxiliary Turbine Bearing Vibration
incidents.response_status: Lubrication flushed and scheduled for ANT-030 overhaul.

incidents.title: Mooring Hawser Tension Warning
incidents.response_status: Winch slackened 2 meters; ice deflectors positioned.

ai_intelligence.title: Elevated Route Risk: Halt & Sheltered Hold on R-03
ai_intelligence.description: Wind speed increased by 37% over the last 2 hours (28 -> 47 km/h) while visibility decreased by 28% (8.4 -> 5.4 km) along Route R-03.
ai_intelligence.suggested_action: Review route conditions before continuing movement. Maintain sheltered vehicle hold at Survey Zone A waypoint 4.
ai_intelligence.rag_citation: Polar Safety SOP v2.0 - Section 3.2: Severe Weather Stoppage Rules & Crevasse Hazard Protocol.

ai_intelligence.title: Logistics Disruption: Delay Cargo C-017 Transfer
ai_intelligence.description: Cargo C-017 (Deep-Shelf Ice Core Sampling Telemetry, 420 kg) is scheduled for transfer through Route R-03 while environmental risk is currently High.
ai_intelligence.suggested_action: Postpone transfer window by 6 hours until wind drops below 35 km/h. Evaluate alternative inland spur R-09 if delay exceeds 12 hours.
ai_intelligence.rag_citation: Fuel & Power Contingency SOP v4.2 - Section 4.1: Cargo Delay Impact Propagation.

causality_chain.description: Deterministic event propagation connecting environmental telemetry, route safety, mission execution, personnel welfare, and cargo manifests.
